==Notes==
* This boss shares only four [[spawn]] points with four other bosses: [[Sakalo Yawpyawl]], [[Salani Pippip]], [[Karobo Dimdim]], and [[Alana Kepkep]]. This means that a random one of these five will not spawn per map [[instance]].

== Trivia ==
* There are two other grawl bosses that share the Wupwup last name: [[Kaia Wupwup|Kaia]] and [[Utini Wupwup|Utini]].
